Looking for a simple way to get moving, increase your daily steps and fit more activity into your day? Join me for this 15-Minute Walking Workout at Home for Beginners!
This low-impact walking workout is a great way to get your body moving, enjoy some light cardio and add a little more activity to your day without needing a lot of time or space. It's beginner-friendly and suitable for older adults or anyone looking for a shorter, manageable workout at home.
